text:
maria_cs: quick kickoff notes for Novaterra pilot - they're requesting onboarding of a custom NLU model for loan application triage. high priority on PHI-safe handling, HSM-backed keys, short eval window (2 weeks).

sara_novaterra: yes. model name: loan-triage-13b-v1. fine-tuned on support transcripts + redacted docs. main risk: accidental exposure of account numbers or customer SSNs. want canary + A/B with our current rules engine.

devin_se: two infra asks from our side: (1) Private deployment in their VPC with KMS/HSM integration; (2) start with minimal reserved compute (1 GPU, maybe 2 if latency hurts). budget is tight.

raj_ml: safety/eval plan I'll lead. need a redacted sample set (~500 cases) and 200 adversarial prompts. tests: entity redaction checks, prompt-injection sweep, token-leak fuzzing. prefer deterministic harness so we can gate rollout.

olivia_pm: note renewal in ~10 months. this pilot is a conversion opportunity to reserved capacity. success signals: triage precision/recall per-intent, p95 latency < 250ms, and cost per 1k tokens <= target.

maria_cs: proposed next steps: 1) Sara to upload redacted sample bundle to SFTP with redaction checklist; 2) infra ticket for Private + HSM; 3) raj builds eval harness; 4) SE enablement session in 48 hours. @devin_se can you book the session?

devin_se: booking 30m with Novaterra Thu 10:30 PT, inviting eng-ml + infra leads.

sara_novaterra: we'll provide the redacted bundle tonight. also can you share a short legal checklist for PHI definitions? our compliance team asked for that before data transfer.

raj_ml: eval outline (draft):
- smoke: 200 holdout transcripts balanced by intent
- safety: 150 prompt-injection attempts + 200 PII/PHI probes
- leakage: secret-insertion and high-token-distance probes
- metrics: precision/recall, top1/top3 accuracy, hallucination rate, leakage incidents
Pass criteria: zero high-severity leakage and <=2 medium-severity safety failures.

maria_cs: tagging deploy-bot to spin up INFRA ticket and track ETA. I'll also update Novaterra playbook entry and note potential upsell.

deploy-bot: ticket INFRA-8247 created for Novaterra Private VPC + HSM onboarding (assignee: infra-oncall). ETA 4 business days. :robot_face:

devin_se: gating note - pilot will not go live until safety harness passes. fallback if fail: hosted isolated model + strict prompt templates and extra filters.

sara_novaterra: understood. prefer canary rollout to 5% traffic once safety checks pass. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

maria_cs: I'll post a summary after Thu session and attach SFTP link and contact for compliance. closing for now.
